recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future edits to the extension definition should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack, and any stale ServiceRequest diagram artifact should be regenerated or separately reviewed as generated output rather than patched as a standalone semantic fix.
issue_request: FHIR-34206 was an Applied/Persuasive OO change request asking FHIR core to support laboratory add-on orders by deprecating ServiceRequest.specimen, preferring Specimen.request for the normal association, and defining a ServiceRequest specimenSuggestion extension with a CodeableReference(Specimen|ServiceRequest) and optional fallback action guidance.
initial_application: Core commits dda9465736 and b0b8b0e63d initially deprecated ServiceRequest.specimen, expanded the element comment, corrected the specimenSuggestion name, and added a temporary ballot note. Extension Pack commit 647f0be added servicerequest-specimenSuggestion and fallback terminology.
additional_context: Later connected work changed the current interpretation: FHIR-50611 added linked ServiceRequest notes, FHIR-55444 removed the deprecated ServiceRequest.specimen element before R6 final ballot once the Extension Pack version was available, and FHIR-52987/commit 950b596 corrected missing reference short/definition details in the Extension Pack. Current core source still has a stale generated-looking servicerequest.svg reference to ServiceRequest.specimen, but the authoritative XML and narrative source are correct.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The current active ServiceRequest source no longer defines ServiceRequest.specimen and the ServiceRequest notes direct implementers to Specimen.request and the Extension Pack specimenSuggestion extension for known-specimen/add-on scenarios.

related_jiras.note: Resolved that FHIR-34206's approach should address deprecation/removal of ServiceRequest.specimen.
Updated ServiceRequest notes to link Specimen.request and specimenSuggestion guidance after deprecation.
Extension Pack follow-up corrected missing specimenSuggestion reference short/definition details.
Removed deprecated ServiceRequest.specimen once the Extension Pack version was available.
Older add-on order issue later closed as handled by FHIR-34206.

evidence_items.learned: This is the seed decision and establishes the intended ServiceRequest and extension behavior to check.

evidence_items.summary: ServiceRequest is in active build scope, and its notes direct users to Specimen.request for the normal association and to servicerequest-specimenSuggestion for known-specimen/add-on cases.

evidence_items.summary: The Extension Pack defines servicerequest-specimenSuggestion, including CodeableReference(Specimen|ServiceRequest), fallback action, and the reference short/definition.
evidence_items.learned: The extension portion of FHIR-34206 belongs to the Extension Pack and is already present there.

evidence_items.summary: Git history shows initial deprecation and name/note correction in core, later removal of ServiceRequest.specimen under FHIR-55444, initial Extension Pack creation, and a follow-up adding missing reference descriptions.
evidence_items.learned: The current source state is the result of a connected applied issue family rather than an unapplied seed.
